name: demo-video-plugin
description: Build narrated, edited project demos with deterministic app state; Playwright-driven web, launched Electron, or attached-app capture; Playwright or OBS recording; ElevenLabs voiceover; measured timelines; Remotion rendering; and Final Cut Pro export.

interface.shortDescription: Create and finish narrated product demo videos.
interface.longDescription: Turns a project repository into a polished demo video through codebase research, narrative scripting, deterministic app preparation, Playwright-driven capture of web, launched Electron, or attached applications, Playwright or OBS recording, ElevenLabs narration, measured timeline reconciliation, Remotion rendering or Final Cut Pro export, and frame-based review.
defaultPrompt: Create a 90-second narrated demo of this product.
Record this running desktop app through OBS and produce a measured edit.
Export the reconciled demo timeline as a Final Cut Pro project.
Prepare this app for deterministic demo recording.
Review this draft demo and identify what to fix.
